source: IWA Publishing Zambia Cholera History Narrative Review
processing_notes: Source states: 'Widespread cholera outbreaks have occurred in Zambia since 1977, predominantly in the capital city of Lusaka. The first cholera outbreak recorded in Zambia occurred in 1977 with 178 cases; cholera has been recorded nearly every year since then.' - confirms zero cholera transmission in Zambia 1970-1976. Multiple academic sources corroborate 1977 as Zambia's first cholera outbreak year. The 7th pandemic reached southern Africa from 1970 but Zambia documented no cases until 1977. Surveillance system status: present (colonial/post-independence), no cholera reported. Evidence type: Documented_Absence confirmed by academic literature consensus.

source: Xinhua Zambia Declares End of Cholera Outbreak July 2025
processing_notes: Source states: 'Health Minister Elijah Muchima stated: For a sustained period of more than five weeks -- exceeding the international threshold of 28 consecutive days -- no new confirmed cholera cases have been reported in any district across Zambia. The minister emphasized Zambia recorded a total of 496 confirmed cases and nine deaths during this recent outbreak.' Zambia declared end of cholera outbreak July 3 2025. CFR = 9/496 = 1.81%. Outbreak started December 24 2024 Nakonde District. National total - includes all provinces.

source: Xinhua Zambia Declares End of Cholera Outbreak July 2025
processing_notes: Source 1 (Xinhua July 4 2025): Zambia declared end of cholera outbreak July 3 2025 after 5+ consecutive weeks without new cases. Evidence type: Documented_Absence from official declaration and new outbreak detection.
